exemptions.surface: org-kernel/kernel.py primitives that record nothing themselves: carry_packet and publish_frame (the carrier write) and dispatch (the processing step). The direct crossing entrypoints this exemption used to name -- publish_packet, publish_ecosystem_message, publish_ecosystem_from_directory, ingest_frame, consume_addressed_frames, consume_and_respond -- now record every crossing they emit, consume or refuse on the repository and organization ledgers, refuse before any effect without both supplied ledger locations, and are no longer exempt.
exemptions.why_manifest_bound_state_transition_is_n: These primitives are steps inside a crossing that another operation records: org-runtime/crossing.py::egress records each emission it carries as ORGANIZATION_EGRESS_EMITTED, crossing.py::ingress records each disposition it dispatches, and the kernel's recording entrypoints record the crossing their carrier write or dispatch belongs to. A receipt here as well would record one crossing twice, so the primitive emits none, and it cannot verify that its caller recorded it -- it can only require that the caller is able to.
exemptions.enforcement: Each primitive refuses with crossing_custody_required_from_recording_operation unless handed the custody org-kernel/kernel.py::crossing_custody resolves, which requires both supplied ledger locations, this kernel's own repository and organization as the root, and a declared organization-ledger genesis. Tested in org-runtime/tests/test_kernel_crossing_parity.py.
exemptions.required_evidence_or_repair: A custody that binds the calling operation's appended receipt to the primitive's effect, so the kernel verifies the record rather than only the ability to make it, released in the canonical org-kernel and adopted here; then this exemption is removed.
exemptions.next_attempt: On the next canonical org-kernel release

exemptions.surface: AT-04 Stage 1 live-lane code with no workflow: this repository's org-runtime/authentic_live_lane.py and SV-LLM/sandbox live/run_live_llm.py. Their GitHub-hosted runner workflows (organization-authentic-live-lane.yml, sandbox-live-llm.yml) were retired because a runner is an external machine; the code remains and takes its organization-execution identity from GITHUB_REPOSITORY.
exemptions.owning_existing_goal: AT-04 Stage 1 live StegBrowser llm.v1 path (SV-LLM/sandbox)
exemptions.why_manifest_bound_state_transition_is_n: The lanes bind organization execution to the GITHUB_REPOSITORY variable a CI runner sets. With the runner workflows retired nothing invokes them; no manifest-bound admission of the lane on a substrate from the canonical runtime substrate order exists yet, so they have no execution surface. Earlier runner results remain CI-class evidence only, never SANDBOX_RUNTIME_OBSERVED.
exemptions.required_evidence_or_repair: Bind organization execution to the admitted manifest instead of GITHUB_REPOSITORY, and admit the lane through Interlock/InTr on a substrate from the canonical runtime substrate order (STEG-BROWSER-RETAINED-RESIDENT-NODE first), with the organization ledger append performed by that admitted execution; then this exemption is removed.
exemptions.retry_entrypoint: SV-LLM/sandbox live/run_live_llm.py::main once invoked by an admitted substrate
exemptions.next_attempt: When a canonical runtime substrate admits the AT-04 lane manifest

exemptions.surface: Runtime observation of SV-LLM organization transitions named by SV-LLM/.github#30: W4 (Sandbox runtime observation), W5 (TV/TVC-held invocation), W7 (Sandbox work-cycle delivery to provider entities) and W13 (the work cycle's conformance-proposal check invocation). This repository has no committed transition-request surface (.stegverse/transition-requests/) and no workflow that builds a committed request into a manifest, receives it on this organization's ingress and appends its organization receipt to the designated ledger ref (.stegverse/transition-ledger/org-contract.json organization_ledger_ref). No SV-LLM organization receipt for any of these transitions exists.
exemptions.owning_existing_goal: SVORG-LLM-ORG-FOUNDATION-001 (SV-LLM/.github#30 W4/W5/W7/W13; the federation-frame half of W4 is ORG-FED-SV-LLM-001)
exemptions.why_manifest_bound_state_transition_is_n: The reference path (StegVerse-org/.github .github/workflows/organization-ledger-transition.yml) builds each committed request with the StegVerse-SDK manifest builder, installed from a separate checkout, and receives it through resident-runtime/organization_manifest_ingress.py. Neither exists in this repository, and adopting the SDK install would add a dependency, which is forbidden. org-runtime/crossing.py::record appends receipts only inside a run that is supplied both ledger locations; no committed manifest directs such a run here. The Sandbox work cycle's W7 delivery and W13 check (SV-LLM/sandbox#37) are source and CI evidence only.
exemptions.required_evidence_or_repair: A manifest-directed append path for this organization that adds no dependency (a committed request under .stegverse/transition-requests/, received on this organization's ingress, appended to refs/stegverse/organization-ledger and read back from a fresh fetch), then one committed request per W4/W5/W7/W13 transition; each workstream's SANDBOX_RUNTIME_OBSERVED class is claimed only from its read-back receipt. Until then these workstreams carry at most CI_VALIDATED.
exemptions.next_attempt: When a dependency-free manifest-directed append path is adopted into this repository
